'''Nimbasa Town''' (Japanese: '''ライモンタウン''' ''{{tt|Raimon|Nimbasa}} Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town in the [[Unova]] [[region]] located southeast of [[Nimbasa City]].
[[File:Nimbasa Battle Club.png|thumb|left|220px|Nimbasa Town's Battle Club and the site for the Club Battle]]
Much like Nimbasa City, the town has a theme-park style to it and features a Ferris wheel, although Nimbasa Town has been around longer. It is known to have a [[Battle Club]] built as a stadium that hosts the [[Club Battle]] tournament.

{{Ash}}, {{an|Iris}}, {{an|Cilan}}, and [[Luke]] arrived in Nimbasa Town in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'' to take part in the [[Club Battle]]. Ash mistook the town for Nimbasa City at first when he asked where the [[Gym]] was. Luke then explained that they are two different places. After {{an|Bianca}} caught up with them, the four of them went to the stadium and signed up for the Club Battle. There, they met up with [[Burgundy]], [[Stephan]], [[Georgia]], and [[Trip]], who were also taking part in the tournament. Later, after competing through the rounds, Iris emerged victorious, and the group left Nimbasa Town at the end of ''[[BW042|Club Battle Finale: A Hero's Outcome!]]''.
